content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired for service=embeddings-us-east-1 severity=high. 5xx rate on /v1/embeddings up ~6% over baseline. Alert: embed-5xx-rate > 3% for 2m :rotating_light:
oncall-sre: I’m on it, acked via PD. Investigating initial scope.
carla: Seeing a spike in worker errors in logs: 
```
ERROR: kv_cache_miss: downstream: rpc failed: context deadline exceeded
stack: embed_worker.go:214
```
ben: Is this impacting hosted customers or just Dedicated pools?
dinesh: Quick glance at metrics — traffic concentrated to us-east-1, both hosted and some dedicated customers hitting same route. Host-level 95p latency up too.
alice: Repro on staging? I can run a small load test against spine-embed to reproduce.
oncall-sre: Thanks. First mitigation: draining ~20% of embed workers in us-east-1 to let the autoscaler settle, and shifted traffic to us-west. Executing now.
incident-bot: Autoscaler triggered scale-up request: +8 pods to embed-worker-us-east-1, request id=as-8242.
carla: Adding logs: a recent commit to embedding preprocessor introduced a non-idempotent edge-case in batching. I see failed batch merge attempts returning 500. Rolling the last deploy back on prod-embed-preproc now.
ben: Paste rollback command?
carla: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/prod-embed-preproc --to-revision=42` (running)
dinesh: Also enabled temporary prefix caching fallback: set `EMBED_PREFIX_CACHE=on` for prod router to reduce backend pressure.
maria: Noted multiple customer-facing 5xx errors in last 10 minutes. Paging CS to prepare comms. @support-team FYI.
oncall-sre: Rollback done, healthchecks green for preproc. Embedding 5xx rate falling from 6% -> 1.2% in last 90s.
incident-bot: Metric update: embed-5xx-rate=1.2% (was 6.1%), 95p latency reduced 120ms -> 45ms.
alice: Confirming with quick synthetic: sample requests now succeed.
ben: Any risk of KV cache thundering when traffic shifts back? Keep eye on evictions.
carla: Increasing kvcache capacity by 15% on us-east-1 to avoid immediate evictions. Command: `terraform apply -var 'kvcache.capacity=115'` queued.
dinesh: I’ll watch autoscaler logs; might need to steady downscale to avoid flapping.
oncall-sre: For now we keep traffic routed to us-east at 40% while we monitor. If metrics hold for 10m we'll fully restore.
incident-bot: Customer impact note added to PD incident: ~4% of embeddings requests returned 5xx between 2876543300 and 2876543390; affected customers: subset of hosted API callers.
maria: CS preparing a short blurb: "We experienced elevated embedding errors in us-east-1 between HH:MM and HH:MM. Root cause identified as a recent preprocessor change; rollback applied. We’re monitoring and will follow up with a postmortem."
alice: Logging shows no new errors for last 2 minutes. Synthetic run 100 reqs all success.
carla: Follow-ups: (1) postmortem, (2) add an alert to detect preproc deploys with increased batch-failure ratio, (3) add canary traffic gating on preproc rollout.
ben: Agreed. Also create a short runbook step to auto-fallback to prefix cache when embed errors spike.
oncall-sre: Marking incident as mitigated. Leaving PD incident open for postmortem tasks and CS comms. If anything regresses, re-open.
incident-bot: PD incident updated: status=mitigated, summary=rollback of prod-embed-preproc reduced 5xx rate.
carla: Thanks all. I’ll own the postmortem. Short status update to #general in 15m. :thumbsup:
alice: queued a heartbeat monitor to fire in 5m to ensure stable behavior.
ben: Great. Closing loop here — will follow up with runbook PR after postmortem.
oncall-sre: end of active mitigation at 2876543540 — continuing to monitor.
